claim_text: After 12 months of selumetinib in children with NF1 plexiform neurofibromas, child-reported tumor pain intensity decreased by a mean of 2.14 points on the 11-point NRS (95% CI -3.14 to -1.14; 29 evaluable children).
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). Outcome measures other than Pain Interference Index and visual acuity are not validated in NF1 (per authors); uncontrolled, unblinded patient-reported outcomes. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Pain outcome of selumetinib treatment. Same edge as C0009.
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
